You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts, step by step: a repeal or a
  limit "from 20 January" does not yet apply on 16 January.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the facts.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: If the UR5e arm in the cell is replaced with a UR10e, by how many millimetres does the reach increase?

Facts:
[0] vibration total value to which the hand-arm system is subjected — hasObligation — if it exceeds 2,5 m/s 2 (if it exceeds 2,5 m/s 2) [condition: if it exceeds 2,5 m/s 2] [DIR, Annex I, 2.2.1.1]
[1] guard coverage, wide-angle universal joints — requiresMeasure — at least to the centre of the outer joint or joints (at least to the centre of the outer joint or joints) [condition: in the case of wide-angle universal joints] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.7]
[2] amplitude of movement of components — requiresMeasure — fitted with devices (fitted with devices) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.6]
[3] devices controlling amplitude of movement — requiresMeasure — fitted with devices (fitted with devices) [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.6]
[4] human-machine interface — requiresMeasure — adapting the human-machine interface (adapting the human-machine interface) [REG, Annex III, 1.1.6]
[5] removable mechanical transmission device — requiresMeasure — marked accordingly (marked accordingly) [REG, Annex III, 3.4.7]
[6] essential requirement 1.4.2.3 — requiresMeasure — readily adjustable without the use of tools (readily adjustable without the use of tools) [DIR, Annex I, 1.4.2.3]
[7] recipient machinery attaching system — requiresMeasure — a system for attaching the removable mechanical transmission device (a system for attaching the removable mechanical transmission device) [condition: when the machinery is uncoupled] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.7]
[8] seat vibration reduction — requiresMeasure — reduce the vibrations transmitted to the operator (reduce the vibrations transmitted to the operator) [condition: If the machinery or related product is subject to vibrations] [REG, Annex III, 1.1.8]
[9] devices for controlling movements — requiresMeasure — Devices for controlling movements (devices for controlling movements) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.6]
[10] portable fixing and other impact machinery — requiresMeasure — enabling device (enabling device) [condition: unless the machinery or related product is positioned correctly with adequate pressure on the base material] [REG, Annex III, 2.2.2.1]
[11] essential requirement 2.4.6.2 — requiresMeasure — designed and constructed to facilitate the changing of worn parts (designed and constructed to facilitate the changing of worn parts) [condition: without contamination of the environment] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.6.2]
[12] removable mechanical transmission device — requiresMeasure — protected over its whole length (protected over its whole length) [condition: any part that moves during operation] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.7]
[13] application rate (point 2.4.5.1) — requiresMeasure — means of adjusting the application rate easily, accurately and reliably (means of adjusting the application rate easily, accurately and reliably) [REG, Annex III, 2.4.5.1]
[14] 4.1.2.2 machinery running on guide rails — requiresMeasure — devices, which act on the guide rails (devices, which act on the guide rails) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.2]
[15] moving parts involved in the process — requiresMeasure — a combination of the above (a combination of the above) [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.2]
[16] portable fixing and other impact machinery — requiresMeasure — enabling device (enabling device) [condition: unless the machinery is positioned correctly with adequate pressure on the base material] [DIR, Annex I, 2.2.2.1]
[17] 4.1.2.7 operating position of machinery — requiresMeasure — widest possible view of trajectories (widest possible view of trajectories) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.7]
[18] errors of fitting — requiresMeasure — by information given on the parts themselves or their housings (by information given on the parts themselves or their housings) [condition: failing the design measure] [REG, Annex III, 1.5.4]
[19] carrier enclosure — requiresMeasure — doors fitted with an interlocking device (doors fitted with an interlocking device) [condition: Where necessary in order to fulfil this requirement] [DIR, Annex I, 6.4.1]
[20] portable hand-held machinery — requiresMeasure — supporting surface of sufficient size (supporting surface of sufficient size) [condition: depending on the type of machinery or related product] [REG, Annex III, 2.2.1]
[21] remote-controlled machinery — requiresMeasure — will respond only to signals from the intended control units (will respond only to signals from the intended control units) [REG, Annex III, 3.3]
[22] guard coverage, simple universal joints — requiresMeasure — cover the transmission to the ends of the inner jaws (cover the transmission to the ends of the inner jaws) [condition: in the case of simple universal joints] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.7]
[23] carrier control devices for upward and downward movements — requiresMeasure — means of controlling upward and downward movements (means of controlling upward and downward movements) [condition: Where safety requirements do not impose other solutions] [DIR, Annex I, 6.2]
[24] 1.3.7 moving parts — requiresMeasure — guards or protective devices (guards or protective devices) [condition: where risks persist] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.7]
[25] necessary unblocking of internal parts — requiresMeasure — possible from the outside (possible from the outside) [REG, Annex III, 1.6.5]
[26] signs on the machinery — requiresMeasure — legible at a sufficient distance (legible at a sufficient distance) [DIR, Annex I, 3.6.1]
[27] Annex I, Part A, point 2 essential requirement — requiresMeasure — Guards for removable mechanical transmission devices (guards for removable mechanical transmission devices) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 2]
[28] seat mountings — requiresMeasure — withstand all stresses (withstand all stresses to which they can be subjected) [REG, Annex III, 1.1.8]
[29] protective devices — requiresMeasure — persons cannot reach moving parts (persons cannot reach moving parts) [condition: while the parts are moving] [REG, Annex III, 1.4.3]
[30] 4.3.3 lifting machinery, maximum working load — requiresMeasure — prominently marked (prominently marked) [REG, Annex III, 4.3.3]
[31] outside parts of the guard — requiresMeasure — cannot turn with the removable mechanical transmission device (cannot turn with the removable mechanical transmission device) [REG, Annex III, 3.4.7]
[32] 4.3.3 machinery with configuration-dependent working load — requiresMeasure — load plate (load plate) [condition: Where the maximum working load depends on the configuration of the lifting machinery or related product] [REG, Annex III, 4.3.3]
[33] means of access — requiresMeasure — Handholds and steps (handholds and steps) [REG, Annex III, 3.4.5]
[34] movement of the carrier — requiresMeasure — rigidly guided (rigidly guided) [condition: serving fixed landings] [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.8.1]
[35] moving parts or their housings — requiresMeasure — The same information shall be given on moving parts or their housings (the same information shall be given on moving parts or their housings) [condition: where the direction of movement needs to be known in order to avoid a risk] [REG, Annex III, 1.5.4]
[36] 5.4 stopping, self-propelled machinery running on rails — requiresMeasure — enabling device (enabling device) [condition: for use in underground work] [DIR, Annex I, 5.4]
[37] essential requirement 1.1.5, machinery too heavy to move by hand — requiresMeasure — be fitted with attachments for lifting gear (be fitted with attachments for lifting gear) [condition: Where the weight, size or shape of machinery or a related product or its various component parts prevents it or them from being moved by hand] [REG, Annex III, 1.1.5]
[38] essential requirement 1.5.15, handholds — requiresMeasure — handholds that are fixed relative to the user (handholds that are fixed relative to the user) [condition: Where appropriate] [DIR, Annex I, 1.5.15]
[39] input shaft on recipient machinery — requiresMeasure — enclosed in a protective casing fixed to the machinery (enclosed in a protective casing fixed to the machinery) [REG, Annex III, 3.4.7]
[40] moving parts involved in the process — requiresMeasure — fixed guards (fixed guards) [REG, Annex III, 1.3.8.2]
[41] essential requirement 1.1.5, machinery moved by hand — requiresMeasure — be easily moveable (be easily moveable) [condition: Where machinery or a related product or one of its component parts is to be moved by hand] [REG, Annex III, 1.1.5]
[42] essential requirement 1.1.8 seating, vibration — requiresMeasure — reduce the vibrations transmitted to the operator (reduce the vibrations transmitted to the operator) [condition: If the machinery is subject to vibrations] [DIR, Annex I, 1.1.8]
[43] remote-controlled machinery — requiresMeasure — appropriate means to signal its movements (appropriate means to signal its movements) [condition: under normal conditions of use, exposes persons to the risk of impact or crushing] [REG, Annex III, 3.6.1]
[44] portable hand-held and/or hand-guided machinery — requiresMeasure — supporting surface of sufficient size (supporting surface of sufficient size) [condition: depending on the type of machinery] [DIR, Annex I, 2.2.1]
[45] machinery accesses for persons entering machinery — requiresMeasure — dimensioned and adapted for the use of rescue equipment (dimensioned and adapted for the use of rescue equipment) [condition: In the case of machinery or related products into which persons shall enter for operation, adjustment, maintenance or cleaning] [REG, Annex III, 1.6.2]
[46] essential requirement 6.3.1 — requiresMeasure — designed, constructed or equipped in such a way (designed, constructed or equipped in such a way) [REG, Annex III, 6.3.1]
[47] hand-fed tenoning machinery with several tool holders for woodworking — listedIn — 6. (annex i, part b, point 6) [REG, Annex I, Part B, point 6]
[48] lifting machinery working load per configuration — requiresMeasure — load plate (load plate) [condition: Where the maximum working load depends on the configuration of the machinery] [DIR, Annex I, 4.3.3]
[49] remote control system — requiresMeasure — designed and constructed in such a way as to affect only (designed and constructed in such a way as to affect only) [condition: In the case of remote controls] [REG, Annex III, 3.3]

response.text: {"kind":"unknown","value":null,"text":"The facts do not give the reach of the UR5e or the UR10e, so the increase in reach in millimetres cannot be worked out from them. They only list safety requirements from the Directive and the Regulation.","used":[]}
